depicted_variant: Varian berukuran manusia besar, satu mata di dahi dan mulut raksasa di perut, bulu merah kusut dan kaki terbalik.

visual_requirements.description: Satu mata di dahi, mulut besar di tengah perut, bulu kemerahan panjang, dua tangan berkuku kait, dua kaki yang menghadap belakang.
Menerkam dari cahaya redup hutan, tanpa efek bau berwarna atau aura.

aura: Satu mata, mulut perut dan kaki terbalik c20 serta terkam c10 menyampaikan bahaya tanpa efek generik.
artistic_choices: Dipilih satu mata dahi c20, bukan mata perut c04; tanpa mulut kedua di wajah.
Ukuran manusia besar dari c20, kamera rapat rendah; bukan raksasa tanpa pembanding.
Bulu penuh menutup tubuh; tidak menampilkan korban, bau sebagai kabut, atau tembakan.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MAPINGUARI, the Brazilian forest being in its single forehead eye and belly mouth variant.
ANATOMY: one head with EXACTLY ONE large eye centred in the forehead, NO second eye and NO face mouth; huge open tooth-lined mouth in the middle of the BELLY; body covered in long shaggy REDDISH fur; TWO arms with hook-shaped nails, TWO legs, BOTH feet turned backward so toes point away from its forward-facing torso; large human body size. [mapinguari-c02, mapinguari-c20]
MOMENT: lunging from the deep forest toward us, single eye fixed on viewer, belly mouth wide open, arms spread and curled hook nails reaching, both backward feet readable on the ground behind the knees.
POWER: physical ambush and terrible scream; no visible magic and no stench cloud. Leaves scatter from the movement. [mapinguari-c10]
SCALE & CAMERA: ground-level extreme low angle, frame includes both feet and dominates from feet to head; tight foreshortened full-body portrait, no giant scale exaggeration.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one late sun shaft from a break in the canopy, deep warm black shadows, plain damp haze.
SURFACE: thick matted rust-red fur, dark rough skin around the single eye and belly jaws, muddy feet, mossy roots.
SETTING: dim deep forest. [mapinguari-c10]
MOOD: dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least 1024px; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
reason: Kaki terbalik c20 tidak terbaca jelas: kaki kiri layar menyerupai jari menghadap penonton, kaki kanan menyamping. Uji anatomi gagal meski mata tunggal/mulut perut dan ancaman bagus.
